verification.value: business acquisition finance arranged through a broker

Vendor finance means the seller agrees to receive part of the purchase price over time. A business acquisition loan is external lender debt used to complete the purchase, and buyers often combine both when cash and debt do not cover the full price.

Emet Capital is a commercial finance broker: it does not lend or fund loans, and it helps eligible business borrowers compare business acquisition funding pathways where the transaction has a clear commercial purpose.
Emet Capital is a commercial finance broker: it does not lend or fund loans, and it helps eligible business borrowers compare options from lenders.
It's a good idea to compare loan products from multiple lenders before applying
Vendor finance tends to fit when trust, documentation, and seller risk appetite are strong.
Emet Capital provides commercial lending solutions to eligible business borrowers.
Emet Capital helps commercial borrowers compare business acquisition funding pathways where the transaction has a clear commercial purpose and the borrower needs a structured lending solution.
Use vendor finance when trust, documentation, and seller risk appetite are strong.
